name: TORO R26

specs.notes: A 2026-shape Formula car, run here to FORMULA APEX's balanced rules (the class's: 800 kg, a 120 kW MGU-K, DRS; see docs/track_racing.md) so the class's three race evenly. The real 2026 rules it was drawn to: 768 kg, a 3,400 mm maximum wheelbase (this model's exactly), 1,900 mm wide, a 350 kW MGU-K and no MGU-H, active aero instead of DRS (Honda's 2026 regulations overview, F1Technical's 2026 numbers). Power, torque, ratios and aero are the class's estimates.

garage.blurb: A 2026-shape single-seater: tiny, pointy and twitchy at the rear, it rewards a driver who's brave on the brakes.

interior.notes: The model's own cockpit: its steering wheel (screen, rev and KERS lights) cut out by material, belts, halo; the driver lying back.

source.author: unknown (the owner's private download: no licence or author in the archive)
source.license: unknown: the owner's private download, used at the owner's request for their own game (2026-10-11)

limitations: Provenance: its textures are named like an Assetto Corsa mod's ('AC_black', 'gp21_cinture', 'kers_blue'): likely a game-mod port. The owner chose to use it for their private game.
Its team livery, decals and race number are gone (the paint is the game's, the decals dropped); the tyre sidewalls keep their maker's lettering.
Raced to FORMULA APEX's balanced rules, not the real 2026 ones (see specs.notes).
